Kir

A fugitive from Jigran

Kir is the Joon protagonist of Lost in Astral. He escaped from Firez on Jigran, leaving his family enslaved, and hopes to return to free them. A recruiter’s promise of work instead leads to his enslavement on Suslanger. In the slave pen he meets Kel, who saves him after a beating, gives him the short name Kir and helps plan their escape. [1, 2, 3, 4]

The road home

Kir and Kel seek refuge, information about the Joons and a route to Gipath’s Great Magician Tka-Rik. The magician has not heard of Jigran, but the Magic Orb points them toward Ingos. There they become involved in the investigation of Brissen’s murder. Yam-Akara eventually identifies an old passage to Jigran, and Kir chooses to follow it with Kel rather than turn back. [5, 6, 7, 8, 9]

Return to Jigran

Back on Jigran, Kir aids Baron Virril against Firez, frees the elder Tui-Len and rescues Tai-Ilara, the woman he remembered from childhood. Kel’s death while retrieving Tai-Ilara’s belongings makes him confront the difference between that childhood attachment and Kel’s loyalty. Firez later reveals that he too is a Joon and claims that his necromancy was meant to protect their people from the Curse. This is Firez’s justification, not an endorsement of his actions. [10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15]
